description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for the LibXDiff library, which provides file diff and merge functionalities.

methods.name: xdl_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff operation between two memory-mapped files.

methods.name: xdl_merge
methods.description: Merges two files based on a common ancestor.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_first
methods.description: Retrieves the first part of a memory-mapped file.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a memory-mapped file.
